subject: What to Pack for GF Travel in Scotland

media.alt_text: Graphic packing list card for gluten-free travel in Scotland

caption.body:
What I pack for Scotland as a celiac:

A celiac dining card (even in English — some kitchen staff are ESL), GF snack bars for the long Highland drives between towns, and GF oat cakes since traditional Scottish ones often use non-GF oats.

Also: waterproof layers, because the weather genuinely changes every 20 minutes, and comfortable walking shoes — you'll cover more ground than you expect.

The Highlands can be remote between towns. Bring snacks for the road rather than counting on finding GF options in every village.
